Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story.
Create ONE production 12-frame RUN/SPRINT cycle sprite sheet of the exact white-haired young fantasy traveler 初页. This is a new running action matching the approved walk character, not a redesign.
INPUT ROLES: Image1 is the AUTHORITATIVE 12-pose skeleton/geometry control sheet. Image2 is the APPROVED character look, clean gray background, body proportions, paper-facet drawing and colored boot ID marks. Image3 original character concept, Image4 side-view model, Image5 parts inventory. Follow Image1 for action; images2-5 for identity and clothing.
OUTPUT: 1536x1536 square sheet. Exactly 4 columns x3 rows, equal cells384x512, reading order01..12. No gutters, lines, numbers, labels or skeleton overlays in the final. Each cell contains exactly one complete character, full body, no clipping. Same orthographic RIGHT-FACING side camera, identical head/boot size, constant limb lengths and camera scale. Local hip x192, head x250, logical ground y450. Controlled up/down pelvis bob from guide only, never arbitrary zoom or cell-by-cell repositioning.
MOTION MUST FEEL POWERFUL, FAST, ELASTIC AND EXPLOSIVE: 24-30degree forward torso lean from hips, stable forward-focused face, assertive opposing bent-elbow arm pumping, deep load/compression, hard backward toe push, long trailing leg, high heel recovery, decisive forward knee drive, clear airborne phases with BOTH feet off ground. Cape/sleeve edges and hair tips stream backward with delayed secondary motion. The speed and force must come from the actual body poses. No speed streaks, dust or FX.
CRITICAL IDENTITY / OCCLUSION: Anatomical RIGHT leg is the ORANGE-DOT boot, NEAR/OUTER, LIGHT IVORY along thigh/knee/calf/cuff/boot in EVERY frame. Anatomical LEFT leg is the BLUE-DOUBLE-STROKE boot, FAR/INNER, consistently shaded GRAY along the entire chain in EVERY frame. At all crossings, RIGHT ivory leg is drawn above LEFT gray leg. Horizontal front/back foot position never changes near/far identity. An orange leg never suddenly becomes gray, nor a blue leg white. The orange dot and blue two strokes stay attached to their exact anatomical boot for the entire12frame cycle. Colored skeleton arms in image1 indicate motion only; actual arms/clothes stay grayscale. Colored marks ONLY on boot cuffs.
FOLLOW EACH EXACT POSE IN IMAGE1, not generic random run poses:
01 right/orange forward forefoot landing and flexing knee; left/blue rear heel folded up behind.
02 right/orange support foot under hip, maximum load/compression; left/blue heel recovering forward while still raised.
03 right/orange powerful rearward toe push, extending leg behind; left/blue knee drives high forward, boot still raised.
04 both airborne, right/orange fully stretched far BACK, left/blue bent and advancing FORWARD. Dynamic split-flight.
05 both airborne, right/orange heel flicks back toward seat, left/blue extends forward and down.
06 both airborne, right/orange rear heel tucked high, left/blue descends forward preparing its landing.
07 left/blue forward forefoot landing; right/orange rear heel folded up. Same phase as01 with anatomical legs swapped in time, NOT swapped in depth or labels.
08 left/blue support foot under hip and compressing; right/orange heel recovers forward raised.
09 left/blue strong rearward toe push; right/orange knee drives high forward.
10 both airborne, left/blue fully stretched far BACK, right/orange bent advancing FORWARD.
11 both airborne, left/blue heel flicks back toward seat; right/orange extends forward and down.
12 both airborne, left/blue rear heel tucked high; right/orange descends forward preparing01. Do not duplicate01as12. 12->01 seamless continuation.
Right leg completes all12phases; left is6frames offset. Skeleton lengths fixed, normal knee direction and joints, no rubber stretching, reversed knees, extra limbs or missing boots.
CHARACTER INVARIANTS: Exactly the same youthful large head and delicate face, ONE ahoge, white short layered hair, tall folded collar, diamond chest clasp, short tunic, short shorts, three overlapping paper cape panels, paired bell sleeves, paired bare hands and matching folded-cuff white ankle boots. Keep clothing attached and structurally consistent. No new scarves, belts, gloves, armor, weapons, ribbons, extra cape tails or redesigned boots. Hands may naturally curl for sprinting but remain the same ungloved hands. Cape can flare backward by bending/folding, not grow or lose panels. Near sleeve/forearm can cross in front of chest and far arm behind torso naturally.
STYLE: Exact refined pencil/gray linework, off-white paper costume, soft faceted paper shading and restrained grayscale of image2. Gray inner leg is clearly darker than ivory outer. No pixel art, crude puppet, 3D render, photoreal or older muscular character.
BACKGROUND: Same uniform medium gray as approved image2, nominal#7d7d7d. Absolutely NO halo, vignette, glow, spotlight, gradient, drop/ground shadows or texture. Clean thin outline edges. No text/watermarks.
QUALITY: Twelve distinct, sequential anatomical sprint poses with accurate support vs flight as listed, not twelve unrelated illustrations. Strong asymmetrical action with hips/shoulders counter-rotation. Fixed silhouette scale and cell anchors; preserve boot identity and complete all legs before repeating.
